90.literal: If I bring along a bunch of different girls, they give me pocket money just for that, and...
90.official: So, if you show up with a pack of girls every time the bosses invite you drinking, they remember you. Half the time they give me cash on the spot.

91.literal: There's no point unless you claw your way to the top.
91.official: If you're in this business, you've gotta claw your way up that ladder using any means possible. Right?

92.literal: Tonight, you're going to keep me company all the way to the end.

93.official: (It looks like that loan shark set me up.)

94.literal: (I wonder what the trick behind all this is / how this whole thing works...)

96.literal: If I'll do, I'm happy to hear you out.
96.official: I can't promise much, but I'm happy to lend you an ear.

97.literal: I've got a favor to ask you, boy!
97.official: I had a favor I wanted to ask you.

98.literal: Hey, old man... is this the young guy you meant?

100.literal: ...Don't tell me, that one million yen—

102.literal: You'd better cough up the cash before you get hurt—for your own good, yeah?

103.literal: Don't drag me into your troublesome mess.
103.official: I told you, this has got nothing to do with me.

104.literal: In other words, you've got no confidence, huh?

105.literal: ...It's no use trying to egg me on like that.

106.literal: Pay your own damn debt yourself.

107.literal: The world's crawling with guys like that, you know?

109.official: I feel terrible, just terrible for all the hassle I caused.

110.literal: Two million?! Like I can trust a story like that!
110.official: You wanna pay me double!? Like I'm gonna buy that!

111.official: You're drunk off your ass, old man!

113.literal: The guy behind you there fights, and...
113.official: You have your tank back there fight us for it.

114.literal: But if we win, we won't pay the money.
114.official: We win, and we don't owe you a thing.

115.literal: Even if the three of you gang up together, you still can't win.

116.literal: Just so you know, I have no intention of helping.

117.literal: Kamoji-kun's just gonna put in a little effort, okay?

118.literal: Boy, keep your eyes on Kamoji-kun's movements.

119.literal: An amateur shouldn't push his luck.

120.literal: The other guy's punches aren't landing at all, huh.
120.official: Bruno barely got a punch in!

122.literal: You're still going at it with those wimpy punches?

123.literal: Heh... Well, I guess there's no helping it.

124.literal: I didn't have the slightest bit of motivation, but...

125.literal: ...but once I saw his technique, I changed my mind.

127.literal: Wha... Bruno's getting beaten so one-sidedly...

128.literal: Who the hell are you, anyway?

129.literal: Uh, ah, so you were an actual (professional) yakuza...!?

130.literal: We're— no, I mean, we're with Toko Credit.

132.literal: In that case, I think he's at the office right now.

133.literal: ...So with this, my debt is cleared?

134.literal: That's the rule of debt collection.
